name: Milky Way
about: a galaxy from three views (tools/galaxy_xyz.py), size x size pixels each, kpcPerPx a pixel: y seen from above, rows +U, columns +W; x seen along U, columns +W, rows -Y; z seen along W, columns +U, rows -Y (Y up, out of the disc). In the galaxy's own frame (fitted.json: X its long axis, Z its short one, parsecs from its middle) a place is at W = X wAxis[0] + Z wAxis[1], U = X uAxis[0] + Z uAxis[1], so at column middlePx.col + W / kpcPerPx, row middlePx.row + U / kpcPerPx of the views. Light is sRGB^2.2.

profile.name: Milky Way
profile.source: the Milky Way model of universe.json starField (an exponential disc of localDensity 0.14 systems/pc³ at 8 kpc, scale length 2.1 kpc, height 350 pc, ending 16-20 kpc, and its bulge), its stars per pc² seen from above as a magnitude (25 - 2.5 log10): only the shape matters, the total is set by the stars at the Sun; byRadius: each ring of the map made as bright as this on average (tools/galaxy_xyz.py)

light.about: the light put back (tools/galaxy_xyz.py --profile): 16-bit, 0 none, else log10(light) = lo + (v - 1) / 65534 (hi - lo)
